comparison_method: Exact local candidate-card input/output contract review plus source SHA-256 binding; no performance or reviewer-independence benchmark was performed.

compared_tools.version: toolbox-wrapper-0.1.0; upstream Task103 Evidence Program validator
input_contract: fixed checked-out ignition/evidence-program snapshot plus containing checkout Git metadata for read-only ancestry checks
output_contract: compact validator status, check count, failure count, and bounded failure details
SHA-256 digest and file count for the complete checked-out Evidence Program tree
validator source SHA-256 and local Git root identity
compared_tools.functional_relation: Runs the fixed repository evidence-program validator and returns a source-tree digest; it does not compare two review finding sets.

input_contract: UTF-8 JSON stdin containing one component validation plan, one workflow run/jobs snapshot, one artifact inventory with extracted basenames and completeness flag, and an optional component validation receipt.
output_contract: Deterministic JSON receipt with plan/run/artifact identity bindings, selected-target IDs, receipt presence or binding status, observed job intervals, source/tool digests, and explicit non-claims.
compared_tools.functional_relation: Maps a validation plan and its targets to one Actions run snapshot; it does not reconcile audit disposition or evidence-reference differences.

input_contract: Bounded UTF-8 JSON stdin with requirement IDs, literal query terms, maximum sources per requirement, total raw-source byte budget, and maximum excerpt length
output_contract: Ranked Knowledge-index candidates with exact repository source paths and indexed/current SHA-256 comparison.

Current raw line matches with line numbers, matched and missing query terms, current/indexed SHA-256 comparison, at most 8 excerpts per source, matched-line count, truncation flag, and explicit partial/unopened/missing statuses.
Requirement-level navigation hints and unresolved gaps; sufficiency_decision is always NOT_EVALUATED.
compared_tools.functional_relation: Finds bounded raw source lines in the checked-out Knowledge index; it does not compare caller-supplied review records.

input_contract: UTF-8 JSON object with exactly comparison_id, baseline_packet, candidate_packet; each packet is a knowledge.assemble_context_packet R0 result.
output_contract: Matched caller-declared task binding, exact UTF-8 excerpt-text byte/character/line counts, source identity counts, and declared obligation set differences without echoing excerpts.
Explicit NOT_EVALUATED semantic coverage and sufficiency, NOT_MEASURED provider tokens/cost, and execution_authorized=false.
compared_tools.functional_relation: Compares same-task ContextPacket excerpt and obligation structures, not audit finding records.

finding: The reviewed neighbors validate one fixed evidence tree, attribute one Actions validation snapshot to planned targets, find bounded raw evidence, or compare structural ContextPackets. None accepts two same-target audit finding records and reports missing/shared findings, disposition differences, and evidence-reference set differences.

retirement_review.basis: Inputs and outputs differ; comparison evidence does not establish that this tool covers any neighbor's valuable use cases.

limits: Caller-declared reviewer references are unauthenticated; independent review is not established.
Evidence refs and digests are echoed but not read or authenticated.
One local invocation demonstrates interface execution only; no reduction in false PASS, review time, or audit error was measured.
